267000|3659e88f.text: Y vohl veld ver goth thor, aesire lon nuff. Lon ver rothas bor vil, se lo nud vohl ru danieb agol lu vrum o Rothas.

275210|b164128f.name: Teller Rames
275210|b164128f.text: I hope we can open up soon. The city needs us!

276235|b53df369.name: Archmage Modera
276235|b53df369.text:
Ah, $N. There you are. I trust the guards have been more hospitable to you now that you've proven yourself?

Keep your nose out of trouble and you won't have any trouble from us.

79096-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79096-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79096-progress.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

96984-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
96984-complete.text:
Oh my, a shade of the archmage? How utterly embarrassing for them.

And the Kirin Tor allowed you into their inner chambers? Interesting. This could provide an opportunity...
96984-complete.title: Heart of Disruption

96984-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
96984-progress.text: You were right to come straight back to me. Have you found anything in Dalaran?
96984-progress.title: Heart of Disruption

96987-accept.name: Syllaa
96987-accept.text:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987-accept.title: Opportunistic Education

96987-complete.name: Unknown
96987-complete.text:
I guess I shouldn't have sent a stooge to look for priceless artifacts. This is barely worth sellin' at a tourist kiosk! What, did you just grab the first book that seemed to be jutting out from the rest?

Forget it. Maybe I can spray it with gold and say it belonged to an arch mage or somethin'.
96987-complete.title: Opportunistic Education

96987-progress.name: Unknown
96987-progress.text: Well? Didja find their library? There's gotta be somethin' good in there.
96987-progress.title: Opportunistic Education

97287-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
97287-accept.text:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287-accept.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97287-complete.name: Archmage Celindra
97287-complete.text:
You would give this... willingly?

I do not know your game, $r, but I cannot deny the value of your interference during this delicate time for our people. I will grant you access to the city in exchange for the mote, but know that we will be keeping an eye on you. A very close eye.

Now be gone while the Kirin Tor discuss this further. Pray you are not found wanting.
97287-complete.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97287-progress.name: Archmage Celindra
97287-progress.text: You are the Horde, $c,  Modera spoke of. Tell me why I should not have your essence shattered into dust right this instant?
97287-progress.title: Shrewd Negotiations
